## POST `/api/instances/supportAssist/{id}/action/initialize`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Initialize the SupportAssist. If only accessKey and pin are passed in, initialize SupportAssist through direct connection. . If accessKey and pin are passed in with gatewayAddresses, initialize SupportAssist through gateway. Access Key can be generated from Product Support Page in Dell website. You can visit the page from Support->Product Portal->Unity Portal in Unisphere GUI.

| `accessKey` | string | It is a verification code generated by serial number. Values are: An eight-bit ASCII string of numbers and letters. The value must match all of following regex expressions `^[A-Za-z0-9]{8}$` |
| `pin` | string | It is an arbitrary four-digit number entered by the user . Values are: A four-digit number. The value must match all of following regex expressions `^[0-9]{4}$` |
| `gatewayAddresses` | array of string (IPv6 supported: false, Prefix-length supported: false, Port supported: true, DNS name supported: true) | Specify the list of gateway addresses to be used to initialize, the addresses won't be persisted to supportAssist after initialization. Supports IPv4 or Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN). Required version: Secure… |

**Responses:** `204` No Content
